question: Who among the following was defeated by Prithviraj Chauhan in the first battle of Tarain?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Muhammad Ghori**__**.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prithviraj Chauh**an was the last leader of Chauhan tradition to sit on the lofty position of Delhi.
 
• Muhammad Ghori attacked India in** 1191.**
 
• In the primary skirmish of Tarain, Prithviraj crushed his military.
 
• **First Battle of Tarain (1191),** in which the Chahamana ruler Prithviraj Chauhan crushed the Ghurid king Mu'izz al-Racket.
 
• He crushed Muhammad Ghori multiple times, but in the seventeenth time; Muhammad Ghori got triumph over the Rajput rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Second Battle of Tarain (1192)**, in which the Ghurid ruler Mu'izz al-Noise crushed the Chahamana lord Prithviraj Chauhan.
 
• **Third Battle of Tarain (1216),** in which the Mamluk ruler Iltutmish of the Delhi Sultanate crushed and caught the previous Ghurid general Taj al-Noise Yildiz.
 
• Mahmud Ghazni went after India multiple times between the years** 1000 to 1027 Promotion.**
 
• Iltutmish was a child-in-law of Aibak.
 
• Aibak was the first Muslim Sultanate ruler in quite a while.
